title: 인터넷 고장 신고: 왜 안 되는지 설명하기
objective: You can report an internet problem and explain the cause with -는 바람에.
summary: A call to report an internet outage and book a technician visit.
setting: A phone call to the customer center of an internet company. The customer's home internet stopped working last night.

task.title: Explain and report problems
task.line: Use the words and the -는 바람에 pattern from the dialogue to complete each task.

words.meaning: reporting that something is broken (a fault report)
words.example: 에어컨이 안 돼서 관리실에 고장 신고를 했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The air conditioner didn't work, so I reported it to the building office.
The power went out, so the elevator stopped.
The green light on the router keeps blinking.

words.meaning: to check for problems, to inspect
words.exampleMeaning: Today is the day they inspect the boiler.

words.meaning: to submit a request, or to receive and log one
words.example: 수리 신청은 홈페이지에서도 접수할 수 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: You can also submit a repair request on the website.

words.meaning: because (of something unexpected that caused a bad result). Always use -는, even for past events. The result is in the past tense.
words.exampleMeaning: I was late for the meeting because I missed the bus.

dialogue.meaning: Hello, this is the customer center. How can I help you?

dialogue.korean: 어제부터 인터넷이 안 돼서 고장 신고하려고요.
dialogue.meaning: My internet hasn't worked since yesterday, so I'd like to report a fault.

dialogue.korean: 네, 알겠습니다. 혹시 지금 모뎀에 불이 들어와 있나요?
dialogue.meaning: I see. Are there any lights on the modem right now?

dialogue.korean: 어젯밤에 정전이 되는 바람에 모뎀이 꺼졌는데, 다시 켜도 빨간불만 깜빡여요.
dialogue.meaning: The power went out last night, so the modem turned off. Even after I turned it back on, only a red light blinks.

dialogue.korean: 그러면 기사님이 직접 방문해서 점검해야 할 것 같습니다. 언제가 편하세요?
dialogue.meaning: Then a technician will need to visit and check it. When is a good time for you?

dialogue.korean: 내일 오전에 와 주실 수 있어요? 인터넷이 안 되는 바람에 오늘 재택근무를 못 했거든요.
dialogue.meaning: Could someone come tomorrow morning? I couldn't work from home today because the internet was down.

dialogue.korean: 네, 내일 오전 10시에서 12시 사이로 접수해 드렸습니다. 방문 전에 기사님이 먼저 연락드릴 거예요.
dialogue.meaning: OK, I've booked it for tomorrow between 10 a.m. and noon. The technician will call you before the visit.

exercises: Fill in the blank with -는 바람에, using the verb in brackets: 어젯밤에 태풍이 ____ 인터넷 선이 끊어졌어요. (오다)
Join the two sentences into one with -는 바람에: 강아지가 공유기 선을 씹었어요. / 인터넷이 끊겼어요.
Say it in Korean with -는 바람에: You tell the agent that your internet was cut off because the building next door is doing construction work (공사하다).
Answer in Korean, based on the dialogue: 기사님은 언제 방문해요?
answers: 강아지가 공유기 선을 씹는 바람에 인터넷이 끊겼어요.
옆 건물에서 공사하는 바람에 인터넷이 끊겼어요. (옆 건물이 공사하는 바람에 인터넷이 안 됐어요.)
